== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[No Bargain (V) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. '''Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text.''' The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-32E-No_Bargain.png]]), the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-nobargain-pre.gif]]) and the Master List (2013) show the original text of [[No Bargain (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured 21 July 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html); 12 December 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001437/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html); 11 January 2013 (https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html); also on the Virtual master list (VMasterType) to 11 January 2013. Typos, capitals and punctuation are kept as published; icons the list writes out in words are drawn as the printed slip draws them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on your [Reflections 2] Objective; "Xizor" on it (and on Guri) is treated as "Shada". Non-[Permanent Weapon] alien females are Mistryl and Black Sun agents. You may not deploy cards with ability except Mistryl and [Independent Starship] starships. Mistryl (except Kitik) are power +1 (+2 if unique (•)), and, while Scum And Villainy on table, deploy +1. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''Made:''' 10 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 73) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, set mark, slip label and copyright line as printed) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>.spec.json</code> next to the image in the batch C1 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
